detail.longDescription:
Connect with friends across the Epic Ecosystem, with secure sign-in wherever you play. The Epic Games app brings your conversations together with cross-platform text chat and includes Epic Authenticator for fast, secure login on any device. Note: You can’t access the Epic Games Store using this app.

Cross-Platform Text Chat

• Send DMs across mobile, PC, and Fortnite
• Create group chats with up to 16 members
• Turn on notifications to get alerts for new messages
• View your last 30 days of chat history across devices
• Your conversations follow your Epic account everywhere you sign in

Secure Sign-In with Epic Authenticator

• Enable two-factor authentication (2FA)
• Verify your identity quickly on any device
• Keep your account, progress, and purchases safe
• Use sign-in codes or one-tap verification
• Add an extra layer of security wherever you play

One Connected Epic Ecosystem

Your Epic account links your games, devices, friends, and conversations into one social layer that moves with you. Chat with friends, plan your next match, and stay connected across mobile, PC, and Fortnite.

Sign in to get started.
